technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with ADX confirmation and bullish technicals, but multiple overbought conditions and long-term trend weakness limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 46 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed retail sentiment (47% bullish) with elevated fear-greed score (69) suggests caution in greed zone; insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at 67 indicates crisis-level fear, NFP event imminent (0 days), and earnings in 46 days create binary risk; MMM (industrial cyclical) highly vulnerable to macro deterioration.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX strong + stochastic bullish cross + Ichimoku above cloud provide short-term momentum confirmation with defined support at 80.99 for risk management.
debate.key_bear_argument: Multiple overbought oscillators (RSI, Stoch, Williams %R, MFI), bearish long-term structure (EMA/SMA 50/200), zero fundamental catalysts, macro crisis (VIX 67, inverted yield curve), earnings binary risk in 46 days, and industrial cyclical exposure make risk/reward unfavorable.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (ADX strong, stoch bullish cross) offers tactical appeal, but entry occurs at resistance with multiple overbought oscillators and price below TEMA, reducing probability of profitable swing execution.
decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis environment (VIX 67, inverted yield curve) combined with earnings binary risk in 46 days and industrial cyclical exposure creates asymmetric downside for MMM; overbought technicals vulnerable to mean reversion.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MMM with 32 existing Industrials positions (37% of portfolio); sector concentration and ticker overlap reduce conviction further; skip entry to avoid compounding cyclical exposure into macro headwinds.
